packageRules.description: Update these with the resolved devenv toolchain and runtime notice evidence; see docs/DEPENDENCY-MAINTENANCE.md.

prBodyNotes: Update matching locks, regenerate and review credits with `devenv shell -- mondek licenses`, and run license/static/native plus relevant packaged checks before merging.
Review coupled runtime/image/tool pins and frozen SDK compatibility explicitly. This bot does not regenerate Mondek's notice evidence or publish artifacts.
Run `python3 scripts/dependency_pins.py --toolchain` inside devenv; partial coordinated updates fail CI. Generated notices must be refreshed by a maintainer before this PR can pass.
